verifications.claim: Selection Sunday for the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's and Women's Basketball Tournaments took place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Date: Sunday, March 15" (R1); "Selection Sunday for 2026 March Madness was Sunday, March 15. The 68-team brackets for the men's and women's NCAA DI basketball tournaments" (R2); "announced on Sunday, March 15" (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm Selection Sunday on March 15, 2026, for both men's and women's tournaments.

verifications.claim: The 68-team men’s bracket was revealed at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Time: 6 p.m. ET TV: CBS" (R1); "The men's tournament bracket was announced at 6 p.m. ET on CBS" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match for men's bracket reveal time and channel in R1 and R2.

verifications.claim: The women’s bracket was revealed at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The women's bracket will be revealed at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN" (R2); "Selection Sunday: 8 p.m. ET Sunday, March 15 on ESPN" (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match for women's bracket reveal time and channel across sources.

verifications.claim: Men's Selection Show was at 6 p.m. ET on CBS, CBS Sports.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Time: 6 p.m. ET TV: CBS" (R1); "Additional coverage: CBS Sports HQ" (R1); "6 p.m. ET on CBS" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Time and CBS directly supported; CBS Sports mentioned for additional coverage/experts but not primary channel.

verifications.claim: Women's Selection Show was at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN, NCAA.com.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "8 p.m. ET on ESPN" (R2, R3, R4); no mention of NCAA.com as broadcast platform
verifications.reasoning: Time and ESPN directly supported; NCAA.com not mentioned as airing platform (sources hosted on NCAA.com but specify ESPN).

verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: Men's: "March 17-18 First Four" (R1, R2); Women's: "First Four: March 18-19" (R2, R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Men's First Four on 17-18 (R1, R2), women's on 18-19 (R2-R4), contradicting for unspecified gender.

verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: Men's: "First round: Thursday, March 19 and Friday, March 20" (R1, R2); Women's: "First round: March 20-21" (R2, R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Men's First Round on 19-20 (R1, R2), women's on 20-21 (R2-R4), contradicting for unspecified gender.

verifications.claim: Sunday, March 15, 2026 marks the official beginning of March Madness.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe March 15 as Selection Sunday/bracket reveal, but official games begin later (First Four March 17+); no claim of it being 'official beginning'.
